HADESANCIENTS-ARTEMIS_ANCIENT.title: Artemis
HADESANCIENTS-ARTEMIS_ANCIENT.talk.ANY.0: Take this, {:gendered:Brother|Sister|Sibling}, and go find your mark.
HADESANCIENTS-ARTEMIS_ANCIENT.talk.ANY.1: Tread ever softly and strike swift and true, {:gendered:Brother|Sister|Sibling}.
HADESANCIENTS-ARTEMIS_ANCIENT.talk.ANY.2: Happened to be in the area again, so thought I'd stop on by.
HADESANCIENTS-ARTEMIS_ANCIENT.talk.ANY.3: May Moonlight guide you to your prey, and expose his every weakness.
HADESANCIENTS-ARTEMIS_ANCIENT.talk.ANY.4: I have to say, these woods are not my favorite...
HADESANCIENTS-ARTEMIS_ANCIENT.talk.ANY.5: I can't venture any further below, though I can give you this.
HADESANCIENTS-ARTEMIS_ANCIENT.talk.ANY.6: The skilled {:gendered:huntsman|huntress|hunter} keeps {:gendered:his|her|their} bag of tricks full and with {:gendered:him|her|them} at all times.
HADESANCIENTS-ARTEMIS_ANCIENT.talk.ANY.7: Steady yourself, {:gendered:Brother|Sister|Sibling}. You have my full support and more.
HADESANCIENTS-ARTEMIS_ANCIENT.talk.ANY.8: May your aim ever be true. Not unlike mine!
HADESANCIENTS-ARTEMIS_ANCIENT.talk.ANY.9: I still think you should try a bow again sometime...
HADESANCIENTS-ARTEMIS_ANCIENT.talk.ANY.1: We hunt alone. Although these run-ins aren't so bad!
Always a pleasure working with you, {:gendered:Brother|Sister|Sibling}.
Go cut that wretched Architect down to size for me, would you?
May none dare stand between a witch and {:gendered:his|her|their} prey.
Fine night for hunting the Architect, don't you think?
Picked up the scent of a few stragglers I'll take care of after this...
You'll find your mark. I know you will.
Yours is the most dangerous prey of all. I'm a bit envious!
Here's a little something to go with those witching arts of yours.
I've got your back, {:gendered:Brother|Sister|Sibling}, so just keep moving forward.
HADESANCIENTS-ARTEMIS_ANCIENT.talk.ANY.2: Got to say it's nice to get away from it all like this.
You tracked *me* down this time, I'll have you know!
You were born to do this, {:gendered:Brother|Sister|Sibling}, and you're going to succeed.
Sure beats being back on that mountaintop, let me tell you.
The Moon is full again. May our combined might take you far.
A new Moon marks a new beginning, so take heart, {:gendered:Brother|Sister|Sibling}.
The Moon's light wanes again, but your strength needn't falter.
As the light of the waxing Moon intensifies, so too does our potential, {:gendered:Brother|Sister|Sibling}.
HADESANCIENTS-ARTEMIS_ANCIENT.talk.first: It's been too long, {:gendered:Brother|Sister|Sibling}. Look at you, on your great hunt! Not the ideal circumstances but you've finally begun. Know that the family has your back, surprised as they are about this.
